concerns.text: Tasks T015a and T046 mandate calculating the SD for entropy tolerance `r` on the N=120 truncated series. This violates FR-010 which explicitly requires SD to be calculated 'using ONLY the time points remaining after motion scrubbing' (which may be >120). Truncating before SD calculation semantically weakens the mathematical definition of the entropy parameter relative to the signal's actual variance.

Tasks T023c, T023d, and T024b introduce a feature selection step (reducing connectivity features to ~50) and an 'exploratory' model. The spec (FR-008, SC-001, SC-002) strictly defines the baseline as 200 PCA components and does not authorize feature selection or exploratory models for the primary claim. This introduces scope creep and risks confusing the primary success criteria verification.

Task T052 implements a streaming data loader to handle RAM constraints. The spec's Assumptions section states the computation is feasible on standard CPU performance and does not define a RAM constraint requiring streaming. This is an unverified scope addition that assumes a constraint not present in the spec, potentially altering the data hygiene or reproducibility guarantees.
